title: WHO confirms outbreak; Cape Verde refuses dock
body: WHO confirms seven hantavirus cases — two laboratory-confirmed and five suspected — including three deaths. The MV Hondius reaches Cape Verde waters and anchors off Praia, but Cape Verde authorities decline to permit docking on public-health grounds. They send a medical team to the ship instead.
